verdict.rationale: Skills managed by the CLI are stored as plain SKILL.md markdown files in local project/global directories or git repos (with an open community specification at agentskills.io/specification.md), so there is no proprietary database locking in a user's skill data — this gives inherent portability rather than a lock-in risk. However, there is no explicit 'export' feature, no documentation of exporting skills.sh leaderboard/account/telemetry data, and a community request even asks for a REST API that doesn't yet exist, suggesting the platform side isn't built for full data portability. missing for 10: explicit export command/feature, documentation on exporting any skills.sh account/telemetry/leaderboard data, and confirmation that all locally-stored data (lockfiles, configs) is guaranteed open-format with no server-side lock-in.
